description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to MediaKeysCapabilities IPC communication in the Rialto client. It includes factory and implementation classes for managing media key capabilities via IPC, with methods to query supported key systems and their versions.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing instances of MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc, with singleton pattern support.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeysCapabilities interface that communicates via IPC to retrieve media key capabilities.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
methods.description: Default constructor for the factory class.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC client.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported key systems via IPC.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to IPC events; always returns true in this implementation.
